question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Baffle
solution:
The correct answer is "**Confuse**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A word that has the same meaning as another word is known as a ***synonym***.
 
• ***Baffle*** means to be ***unclear***.
 
• ***Confuse*** is an appropriate synonym for Baffle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ***Amuse*** means to cause someone to smile or chuckle.
 
• ***Bemuse*** means to gently frustrate a person.
 
• ***Choose*** means to select what or who you want from the options available.
